verdict.rationale: Groq's catalog hosts recent open-weight models such as OpenAI's GPT-OSS 120B. Its deprecations policy describes a preview lifecycle stage, and a community user notes Groq was the only fast provider of Kimi K2 at the time, which hints at early availability. However, no evidence documents how quickly new open-weight releases arrive, and one user reports newer models moved to 'call us for quotes' access. Missing for 10: any documented time-to-availability commitment or track record, changelog entries showing day-0/day-1 launches of new open-weight models, independent corroboration of rapid onboarding, and confirmation that new models are self-serve.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release
